verdict.rationale: NetHunt's pricing page documents a native bulk-update feature for multiple records, plus merging several duplicate records at once. It is scoped to a few named fields, and nothing shows bulk operations via the MCP connection or API for an AI-native workflow. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond the listed fields (e.g. bulk delete or create), bulk actions exposed through MCP or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Update multiple records' fields: stage, status, priority, manager.
Get rid of duplicates by merging several contacts, companies, or deals.
